title: Seed Maker ~No One Realizes This Skill Is a Cheat Yet ~
description:
"Ars, your skill is 'Seed Maker'."

In a world where the gods bestow skills, combat abilities are prized above all else. Yet, the skill Ars received was "Seed Maker." While everyone else writes it off as a complete dud, Ars is the only one who realizes just how much of a cheat skill it truly is...

Armed with a cheat skill in a world of swords and magic, our protagonist's unstoppable rise to the top begins now!
author: Reppuu
